title: [review] provisioning.py:454: Multiple encrypt_seed cal
description: State check at line 447 allows multiple encrypt_seed() calls while state is ESTABLISHED. If called twice before receiving ACK (e.g., retry logic bug generates new seed instead of resending), _provisioned_seed is silently overwritten. ACK verification at line 491-492 then compares against the wrong seed, causing spurious verification failures even though the node correctly received the first seed.
